Link rule applied everywhere: a control links only to that customer's or that order's own board, otherwise it is a plain <button>. Every Receipt, every Take payment on an order (Kato's 1,810,000 included), and every non-Kato Tell are buttons. OR01's Lubowa #0546 Tell pill is a button too: OR13 is #0559, another order. Back and close go to the screen the sheet sits over. Every href resolves to a file in root/project.
Sample values not in FACTS: the mobile money transaction ID on OR25 (1194026113), and #0533's bill total of 1,110,000 (690,000 paid in 3 payments + 420,000 left).
One word for the act: the order action-bar tile says 'Fix it' and the sheet it opens is titled 'Something wrong' (lead ruling).
#0556 and #0557 (all on our shelf) show Checking and Buying as 'skipped' on the rail (OR11) and in the stage dots (OR19).
The Tell sheet has no 3-reason segment (LANGUAGE 5.1): the message is built from the order's state. 'Send as SMS' is offered.
